recognize_zh: 薄層血片中大量大小正常的紅血球內含細小環狀體，常一顆紅血球內有 2–4 個環、雙染色質點與貼邊（appliqué）型；中央可見香蕉形（新月形）配子體兩個重疊於同一紅血球，這些組合是惡性瘧原蟲（P. falciparum）的特徵。
features: High parasitemia of delicate small ring forms in normal-sized red cells without enlargement or Schüffner stippling
Multiple rings within single erythrocytes (up to 3-4), double chromatin dots and marginal appliqué (accolé) forms
Crescent (banana-shaped) gametocytes: two overlapping within one red cell centrally, another at the right edge
No mature trophozoites or schizonts seen in peripheral blood
Segmented neutrophil and scattered platelet clumps in background
describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows numerous erythrocytes infected by small, delicate ring-form trophozoites; infected red cells are not enlarged and lack Schüffner dots. Many cells contain multiple rings, including rings with double chromatin dots and marginal appliqué forms. Crescent-shaped gametocytes are present, including two overlapping gametocytes within a single erythrocyte. No mature trophozoites or schizonts are seen. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria with high parasitemia; percent parasitemia should be quantified and reported urgently.

ddx.vs: Vivax and ovale infect enlarged red cells with Schüffner dots, show ameboid trophozoites and schizonts, and have round rather than crescent gametocytes.
Knowlesi rings can mimic falciparum but lack crescent gametocytes and show band-form trophozoites and schizonts in blood.
Babesia forms pleomorphic rings and tetrad (Maltese cross) forms without hemozoin pigment or gametocytes.

ddx.dx: Platelets overlying red cells / stain precipitate
ddx.vs: Superimposed platelets lack a ring-shaped cytoplasm with a chromatin dot and sit in a different focal plane.
